core_en: You do not really “change” your life. You create a new life from a new identity.
core_zh: 你不是在“改变”人生，而是在用一个新的身份，创造一个新的人生。
label: Chapter 01 · 身份先行

paragraphs.en: Many people make New Year’s resolutions, get excited for a few weeks, and then stop. They try to change what they do, but they do not change who they are. So the old habits come back — the weight, the spending, the low confidence.
paragraphs.zh: 很多人立下新年目标，兴奋几周就放弃了。他们只想改变“做什么”，却没有改变“自己是谁”。于是旧习惯又回来了 —— 体重、花钱方式、自信心都回到原点。

paragraphs.en: Think of a fit person, a focused founder, or an artist who loves their work. They do not need to force themselves every day. Healthy food, deep work, and daily practice are simply part of who they are.
paragraphs.zh: 想想一个身材很好的人、一个专注的创业者，或一个热爱创作的艺术家。他们不需要每天逼自己。健康饮食、深度工作、每天练习，本来就是他们生活的一部分。

paragraphs.en: So the order matters: first become the kind of person who would naturally do those things. Then the results follow — slowly, but surely.
paragraphs.zh: 所以顺序很重要：先成为那种“会自然做这些事的人”，结果会慢慢跟上来。

tip_en: Don’t ask “How can I lose 30 pounds?” Ask “What would a healthy person do today?”
tip_zh: 别问“我怎么减掉 30 磅？”要问“一个健康的人今天会做什么？”
title_en: Change who you are first — actions will follow

vocab.def_zh: 身份；自我认同 — 你认为自己是怎样的人。
vocab.example_en: My identity is “a person who writes every day.”
vocab.example_zh: 我的身份是“每天都写作的人”。

vocab.def_zh: 决心；新年目标。New Year’s resolution = 新年立下的目标。
vocab.example_en: My resolution is to read 12 books this year.
vocab.example_zh: 我的新年目标是今年读 12 本书。

vocab.def_zh: 自律；纪律。不是靠意志力硬撑，而是变成习惯。
vocab.example_en: Discipline is doing it even on a bad day.
vocab.example_zh: 自律就是状态不好的那天也去做。

vocab.def_zh: 真正推动进展；带来实质改变。needle 是仪表盘上的指针。
vocab.example_en: Does this task move the needle, or just keep me busy?
vocab.example_zh: 这件事是真正推动进展，还是只是让我看起来很忙？
